# Where to Watch Chickenhare and the Secret of the Groundhog


by Angel | September 15, 2026


When Chickenhare discovers that an ancient artifact could be the only hope for saving his kind, he sets off on his most daring adventure yet. Joined by his friends, the fearless adventurer journeys deep into a mysterious mountain in search of the legendary groundhog.


But Chickenhare and his friends aren’t the only ones looking for the secret. Their quest quickly turns into a race filled with obstacles, surprises, and unexpected twists.


[Stream Chickenhare and the Secret of the Groundhog now on Angel.](https://www.angel.com/watch/chickenhare-and-the-secret-of-the-groundhog)


### **A Mythical Quest**


According to legend, a mysterious groundhog lives deep within a secret mountain, guarding an ancient power capable of turning back time. When Chickenhare learns that this mythical artifact could help save his kind, he doesn’t hesitate to go after it.


The journey, however, is anything but simple.


Chickenhare and his friends have to navigate the dangers of the mountain while figuring out who else is searching for the groundhog and what they plan to do with its power. Along the way, the adventure delivers plenty of surprises and plot twists to keep the story moving.


### **Chickenhare Is Back**


For fans of the first *Chickenhare* adventure, the sequel brings back the characters and humor they know while sending them on a whole new quest.


One Rotten Tomatoes reviewer called it “the long awaited sequel no one thought we would get,” praising the way the story builds on the original without losing what made it enjoyable. Another Angel Guild member described the adventure, humor, plot twists, and characters as being “back and better than ever.”


But newcomers don’t need to have seen the first movie to join the adventure.


As one reviewer put it, the film works well “if you are experiencing the cinematic universe of Chickenhare for the first time or if you watched the first movie.”


Whether this is a first introduction or a return to the world of Chickenhare, there’s a new mystery waiting to be solved.


### **A Story About Being Yourself**


Underneath the mythical creatures and mountain quests, *Chickenhare and the Secret of the Groundhog* has a simple idea at its center: You don’t have to change who you are to be worthy of belonging.


Chickenhare’s journey gives the story room to explore acceptance, friendship, and the importance of looking beyond how the world sees you.


One Angel Guild member praised the film’s “positive message about accepting who you are,” while a Rotten Tomatoes reviewer highlighted its themes of acceptance and friendship.


Those themes give the adventure a little more heart without taking away from the fun.


### **Watch** ***Chickenhare and the Secret of the Groundhog*** **on Angel**


Chickenhare thought finding the mythical groundhog might be the key to saving his kind. Instead, he and his friends find themselves caught in a race against others who want the ancient power for themselves.


With mystery, humor, friendship, and plenty of unexpected turns, *Chickenhare and the Secret of the Groundhog* brings the adventurous world of Chickenhare back for another journey.


[Stream Chickenhare and the Secret of the Groundhog now on Angel](https://www.angel.com/watch/chickenhare-and-the-secret-of-the-groundhog) and join Chickenhare and his friends on their latest quest.
